4264.title: Pi interaction failures become cancellations
4264.rootCauseOneLine: Provider/core title bounds disagree; validation, transport, and runtime errors all map to cancellation.
4264.proposedFix: Align the canonical title bound and design an explicit bridge-error outcome separate from user cancellation.
4264.caveats: Direct coordinator/core-schema reproduction; runtime responses injected. No desktop or external adapter session tested. Fix exceeds the schema/product-decision limits.
